We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

Let's parse structure: It's a para-methyl phenyl sulfonamide attached to another phenyl ring bearing an α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline (anilide). So overall: p-tolyl-sulfonyl attached to phenyl-CH=CH-CO-NH-aniline.

We need 3 steps retrosynthesis: likely disconnections:

1) Amide formation between carboxylic acid (α,β-unsaturated acid) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). So break C(=O)-N bond to give acid and aniline.

2) The α,β-unsaturated acid could be formed via Doebner modification from aromatic aldehyde (the phenyl ring with aldehyde) and malonic acid, giving the trans-α,β-unsaturated acid attached to phenyl. So break C=C bond and C-CO2H bond? Actually Doebner: aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid -> cinnamic acid (aryl-CH=CH-CO2H). So we can disconnect the C=C double bond to give aldehyde (aryl-CHO) and malonic acid (HOOC-CH2-COOH). So step 2: retro-Doebner gives aldehyde and malonic acid.

3) Sulfonamide formation: break S-N bond to give sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonic acid) and aniline (the p-tolyl amine). Actually target has sulfonamide linking p-tolyl amine to sulfonyl attached to second phenyl. So we can disconnect sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonic acid) attached to phenyl ring (the sulfonyl phenyl) and p-toluidine (p-methyl aniline). So step 3: sulfonyl chloride + aniline -> sulfonamide.

Thus three steps: (i) amide coupling, (ii) Doebner condensation, (iii) sulfonamide formation.

Let's search for amide coupling template: forward reaction: carboxylic acid + amine -> amide (with coupling agent).
